videos.title: AI Is Becoming a Physical Industry
videos.desc: Artificial intelligence may be digital in application, but its expansion increasingly depends on electricity, land, semiconductors, cooling, infrastructure and capital.

videos.title: The Return of Electricity Demand
videos.desc: After decades of relatively modest growth, rising electricity demand is creating new questions about infrastructure, investment and industrial development.

videos.title: Why the Future Still Has to Be Built
videos.desc: Digital technologies can scale rapidly. Power plants, transmission systems, factories and cities cannot. The difference between those speeds increasingly matters.

videos.title: What Energy Abundance Would Actually Change
videos.desc: The consequences of energy availability extend beyond electricity prices, influencing production, transportation, computation and economic possibility.
